title: Everyday Tea and Rice
speaker: Nomon Tim Burnett
summary: The main teaching of this Soto Zen dharma talk emphasizes the importance of approaching everyday activities with mindfulness and awareness, rather than getting stuck in intellectual analysis or preconceived notions about spiritual practice. By rediscovering the wonder and magic in mundane tasks like eating and drinking, we can cultivate a deeper sense of connection to ourselves and the world around us. This approach is rooted in Dogen's concept of "everyday activity," which suggests that even ordinary activities can be a form of spiritual practice when done with intention and awareness.
